Not a flat master-data field -- the acquisition cost is recorded via a posting (ANEK/ANEP, transaction type 1xx), the same 'value lives in a transaction, not the master record' finding as Sales Orders>Unit_Price. Loading historical acquisitions like this is typically a special one-time 'legacy asset data transfer' process (e.g. transaction AS91/ABLDT), not a normal field-to-field load -- flag for the target system's Basis/FI-AA team.

Net book value is a calculated result (APC minus accumulated depreciation via ANLC), not stored master data. Loading it directly would create a value SAP itself would otherwise derive and could contradict once real postings start -- historical NBV needs the same legacy-transfer process as Purchase_Cost, not a field mapping.
